rotationPolicy.notes: Once per day, Scheduled Chat may propose a new visual presentation for class information after reading the canonical JSON and design history. Factual class data must not be rewritten. Apply only after a visual demo is explicitly approved. Once 30 approved designs exist, reuse oldest-first only after the minimum gap.

approvedDesigns.name: Class Map Editorial
approvedDesigns.layout: audience cards + learning-focus strip + learning format + five-step lesson flow + start CTA
approvedDesigns.visualLanguage: jade, cream and gold editorial cards with restrained Chinese seal motifs; teacher media may now be used only when sourced from data/teacher-profile-media.json
approvedDesigns.responsive: four audience cards collapse to two and then one column; focus grid and process timeline become horizontally compact stacked cards on mobile
